quote:
Aidarous's team stood out at our hackathon from the first day. In under 48 hours he led them to build a full ride-sharing platform for our students — a mobile app, an admin dashboard, and the API behind it — and every piece actually worked in the demo.

His leadership and the way he scoped the work were a big part of why they took 1st place out of eight teams. Exactly the kind of student we're proud to have represent the University of Hargeisa.
name: Ceelaabe

quote:
As a judge I saw eight submissions, and Aidarous's was the one that felt like a real product rather than a prototype. They shipped three connected surfaces — student app, driver flow, and admin dashboard — with live notifications and proper authentication, all inside the 48-hour window.

What earned them 1st place was that it was complete and it ran. Nothing was faked for the demo. Clear technical lead, clear priorities, well deserved.
name: Mukhtaar

quote:
Aidarous rebuilt our election results dashboard into something we could actually use on results night. Ten parties, six regions, and instead of scrolling through dense tables our team could open a region, read the histograms and maps, and get the picture in seconds.

The real-time reporting and the region filtering changed how quickly we could respond. He understood what stakeholders needed to see and delivered a tool that held up under pressure.
name: Kaah Party
